description: tests/Unit/ModuleBoundaryTest.php's BASELINE currently permits Feedback module code to depend on a presentation-layer admin concern, which is exactly the arrow the boundary rule forbids. Move the authorization contract into an allowed shared boundary (kernel or a module-owned concern), update the module, delete that BASELINE line, and run the boundary test - a companion test fails on stale entries, so the line must go in the same change.
title: Remove the Feedback to shell BASELINE exemption
